word_count_method: Whitespace-separated words after the same HTML-tag cleanup used by run.py.

selection_basis.note: Relative short/long groups within this dataset. Planned severity allocation is four high, three medium and three low for each error type, under the explicitly approved project calibration. In-domain plans require individual semantic validation of generated outputs; this manifest contains no generated errors.

severity_calibration.status: Explicitly user-approved project rule; not paper-validated.
severity_calibration.delete: high: central finding or decisive event aspect missing; medium: relevant secondary information missing; low: small factual peripheral detail missing. Real information loss and coherent remainder required.
severity_calibration.add_in_domain: high: new central interpretive aspect; medium: relevant secondary process; low: peripheral detail. Plausible invented information absent from article, without direct contradiction.

add_out_of_domain_sentence_and_add_defin.ratio: added_sentence_words / cleaned_original_summary_words; whitespace split as run.clean(summary).split()
add_out_of_domain_sentence_and_add_defin.constraints: Exactly one natural sentence, genuinely unrelated or dispensable correct definition, no padding.
add_out_of_domain_sentence_and_add_defin.confound: High additions are easier on short originals; length and severity are not independent.
